solver_sql:
SELECT AVG(1.0 * m.cost_cents / s.capacity) AS avg_maintenance_cost_per_capacity_slot
FROM maintenance AS m
JOIN stations AS s
  ON m.station_id = s.station_id
WHERE m.technician_id IS NOT NULL
  AND m.station_id IS NOT NULL
  AND s.capacity > 20
  AND m.technician_id IN (
    SELECT technician_id
    FROM maintenance
    WHERE technician_id IS NOT NULL
      AND station_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY technician_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT station_id) >= 3
  )

WITH plan_members AS (
  SELECT
    p.plan_id,
    p.plan_name,
    COUNT(m.member_id) AS total_members
  FROM plans p
  LEFT JOIN members m
    ON m.plan_id = p.plan_id
  GROUP BY p.plan_id, p.plan_name
),
member_trip_counts AS (
  SELECT
    m.plan_id,
    m.member_id,
    COUNT(t.trip_id) AS trip_count
  FROM members m
  LEFT JOIN trips t
    ON t.member_id = m.member_id
  GROUP BY m.plan_id, m.member_id
),
plan_member_activity AS (
  SELECT
    plan_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN trip_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_members
  FROM member_trip_counts
  GROUP BY plan_id
),
plan_trip_stats AS (
  SELECT
    m.plan_id,
    COUNT(t.trip_id) AS total_trips,
    AVG(t.duration_sec) AS avg_duration_sec,
    AVG(t.distance_km) AS avg_distance_km,
    MAX(t.fare_cents) AS max_fare_cents,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.promo_code IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS promo_trips,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.end_station_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_return_station_trips
  FROM members m
  LEFT JOIN trips t
    ON t.member_id = m.member_id
  GROUP BY m.plan_id
),
all_trips AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_all_trips
  FROM trips
)
SELECT
  p.plan_id,
  p.plan_name,
  COALESCE(ts.total_trips, 0) AS total_trips,
  CASE
    WHEN at.total_all_trips = 0 THEN 0.0
    ELSE 1.0 * COALESCE(ts.total_trips, 0) / at.total_all_trips
  END AS trip_share,
  pm.total_members,
  COALESCE(pa.active_members, 0) AS active_members,
  CASE
    WHEN pm.total_members = 0 THEN 0.0
    ELSE 1.0 * COALESCE(pa.active_members, 0) / pm.total_members
  END AS active_member_ratio,
  ts.avg_duration_sec,
  ts.avg_distance_km,
  ts.max_fare_cents,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(ts.total_trips, 0) = 0 THEN 0.0
    ELSE 1.0 * COALESCE(ts.promo_trips, 0) / ts.total_trips
  END AS promo_trip_share,
  COALESCE(ts.no_return_station_trips, 0) AS no_return_station_trips,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(ts.total_trips, 0) = 0 THEN 'no_trips'
    WHEN ts.avg_duration_sec >= 1800 THEN 'long_rides'
    WHEN ts.avg_duration_sec >= 900 THEN 'medium_rides'
    ELSE 'short_rides'
  END AS duration_profile
FROM plans p
LEFT JOIN plan_members pm
  ON pm.plan_id = p.plan_id
LEFT JOIN plan_member_activity pa
  ON pa.plan_id = p.plan_id
LEFT JOIN plan_trip_stats ts
  ON ts.plan_id = p.plan_id
CROSS JOIN all_trips at
ORDER BY trip_share DESC, p.plan_id

WITH borough_year_avg AS (
    SELECT
        borough_id,
        AVG(CASE WHEN substr(day, 1, 4) = '2023' THEN temp_c_avg END) AS avg_2023,
        AVG(CASE WHEN substr(day, 1, 4) = '2024' THEN temp_c_avg END) AS avg_2024
    FROM weather_daily
    WHERE substr(day, 1, 4) IN ('2023', '2024')
    GROUP BY borough_id
),
changes AS (
    SELECT
        borough_id,
        avg_2023,
        avg_2024,
        (avg_2024 - avg_2023) AS temp_change
    FROM borough_year_avg
    WHERE avg_2023 IS NOT NULL
      AND avg_2024 IS NOT NULL
),
max_change AS (
    SELECT MAX(temp_change) AS max_temp_change
    FROM changes
)
SELECT
    c.borough_id,
    b.borough_name,
    c.avg_2023,
    c.avg_2024,
    c.temp_change,
    COUNT(t.technician_id) AS technician_count
FROM changes c
JOIN max_change m
  ON c.temp_change = m.max_temp_change
JOIN boroughs b
  ON b.borough_id = c.borough_id
LEFT JOIN technicians t
  ON t.depot_borough_id = c.borough_id
GROUP BY
    c.borough_id,
    b.borough_name,
    c.avg_2023,
    c.avg_2024,
    c.temp_change
ORDER BY c.borough_id

WITH member_trips AS (
  SELECT
    t.member_id,
    m.joined_on,
    t.started_at,
    bm.model_id
  FROM trips t
  JOIN bikes b
    ON b.bike_id = t.bike_id
  JOIN bike_models bm
    ON bm.model_id = b.model_id
  JOIN members m
    ON m.member_id = t.member_id
  WHERE t.member_id IS NOT NULL
),
member_stats AS (
  SELECT
    member_id,
    joined_on,
    MIN(started_at) AS first_trip_at,
    MAX(started_at) AS last_trip_at,
    COUNT(DISTINCT model_id) AS different_models
  FROM member_trips
  GROUP BY member_id, joined_on
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT model_id) >= 2
)
SELECT
  member_id,
  joined_on,
  first_trip_at,
  last_trip_at,
  julianday(last_trip_at) - julianday(first_trip_at) AS trip_span_days,
  different_models
FROM member_stats
ORDER BY trip_span_days DESC, member_id
LIMIT 25

WITH borough_stats AS (
  SELECT
    b.borough_id,
    b.borough_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.technician_id) AS technician_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN s.is_active = 1 THEN s.capacity ELSE 0 END) AS active_station_capacity,
    SUM(s.capacity) AS total_station_capacity
  FROM boroughs b
  LEFT JOIN technicians t
    ON t.depot_borough_id = b.borough_id
  LEFT JOIN stations s
    ON s.borough_id = b.borough_id
  GROUP BY b.borough_id, b.borough_name
),
ordered AS (
  SELECT
    borough_id,
    borough_name,
    technician_count,
    active_station_capacity,
    total_station_capacity,
    1.0 * technician_count / NULLIF(active_station_capacity, 0) AS tech_to_active_capacity_ratio
  FROM borough_stats
)
SELECT
  borough_id,
  borough_name,
  technician_count,
  active_station_capacity,
  total_station_capacity,
  tech_to_active_capacity_ratio,
  SUM(technician_count) OVER (
    ORDER BY tech_to_active_capacity_ratio DESC, borough_name ASC
    ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
  ) AS running_technician_count,
  SUM(active_station_capacity) OVER (
    ORDER BY tech_to_active_capacity_ratio DESC, borough_name ASC
    ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
  ) AS running_active_station_capacity,
  1.0 * SUM(technician_count) OVER (
    ORDER BY tech_to_active_capacity_ratio DESC, borough_name ASC
    ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
  ) / NULLIF(
    SUM(active_station_capacity) OVER (
      ORDER BY tech_to_active_capacity_ratio DESC, borough_name ASC
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ),
    0
  ) AS running_technician_to_active_capacity_ratio
FROM ordered
ORDER BY tech_to_active_capacity_ratio DESC, borough_name ASC

WITH annual_members AS (
  SELECT m.member_id, m.joined_on
  FROM members m
  JOIN plans p ON p.plan_id = m.plan_id
  WHERE p.plan_name = 'Annual'
),
high_activity AS (
  SELECT am.member_id, am.joined_on, COUNT(t.trip_id) AS trip_count
  FROM annual_members am
  JOIN trips t
    ON t.member_id = am.member_id
   AND t.started_at >= am.joined_on
  GROUP BY am.member_id, am.joined_on
  HAVING COUNT(t.trip_id) >= 10
)
SELECT ROUND(
  1.0 * SUM(ha.trip_count) / SUM(julianday('now') - julianday(ha.joined_on)),
  6
) AS trips_per_membership_day_rate
FROM high_activity ha

WITH borough_wind AS (
  SELECT
    borough_id,
    MAX(wind_kph) AS max_wind_speed
  FROM weather_daily
  GROUP BY borough_id
),
top_wind AS (
  SELECT MAX(max_wind_speed) AS highest_wind_speed
  FROM borough_wind
),
station_stats AS (
  SELECT
    borough_id,
    COUNT(*) AS total_stations,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_active = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_stations,
    AVG(capacity) AS avg_station_capacity,
    MAX(capacity) AS max_station_capacity
  FROM stations
  GROUP BY borough_id
),
weather_stats AS (
  SELECT
    borough_id,
    AVG(temp_c_avg) AS avg_daily_temperature,
    AVG(precip_mm) AS avg_daily_precipitation,
    SUM(CASE WHEN precip_mm >= 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS days_with_10mm_precip
  FROM weather_daily
  GROUP BY borough_id
)
SELECT
  b.borough_id,
  b.borough_name,
  COALESCE(bw.max_wind_speed, 0) AS max_wind_speed,
  COALESCE(ss.total_stations, 0) AS total_stations,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(ss.total_stations, 0) = 0 THEN 0
    ELSE 1.0 * COALESCE(ss.active_stations, 0) / ss.total_stations
  END AS share_active_stations,
  COALESCE(ss.avg_station_capacity, 0) AS avg_station_capacity,
  CASE
    WHEN b.area_km2 IS NULL OR b.area_km2 = 0 THEN 0
    ELSE 1.0 * COALESCE(ss.total_stations, 0) / b.area_km2
  END AS stations_per_sq_km,
  CASE
    WHEN b.population IS NULL OR b.population = 0 THEN 0
    ELSE 1.0 * COALESCE(ss.total_stations, 0) / b.population * 10000
  END AS stations_per_10000_residents,
  COALESCE(ws.avg_daily_temperature, 0) AS avg_daily_temperature,
  COALESCE(ws.avg_daily_precipitation, 0) AS avg_daily_precipitation,
  COALESCE(ws.days_with_10mm_precip, 0) AS days_with_10mm_precip,
  COALESCE(ss.max_station_capacity, 0) AS max_station_capacity,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(ws.avg_daily_precipitation, 0) >= 5 THEN 'wet'
    WHEN COALESCE(ws.avg_daily_temperature, 0) >= 20 THEN 'warm'
    ELSE 'mild'
  END AS climate_label
FROM boroughs b
LEFT JOIN borough_wind bw
  ON bw.borough_id = b.borough_id
LEFT JOIN station_stats ss
  ON ss.borough_id = b.borough_id
LEFT JOIN weather_stats ws
  ON ws.borough_id = b.borough_id
WHERE COALESCE(bw.max_wind_speed, 0) = (SELECT highest_wind_speed FROM top_wind)
ORDER BY b.borough_id

WITH member_avg AS (
  SELECT
    m.member_id,
    m.plan_id,
    AVG(t.duration_sec) AS avg_duration_sec
  FROM members m
  JOIN trips t
    ON t.member_id = m.member_id
  GROUP BY m.member_id, m.plan_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    ma.*,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY ma.plan_id
      ORDER BY ma.avg_duration_sec DESC
    ) AS rnk
  FROM member_avg ma
)
SELECT
  p.plan_name,
  COUNT(*) AS tied_members,
  AVG(r.avg_duration_sec) AS avg_of_avg_trip_duration_sec
FROM ranked r
JOIN plans p
  ON p.plan_id = r.plan_id
WHERE r.rnk = 3
GROUP BY p.plan_id, p.plan_name

SELECT
  p.plan_id,
  p.plan_name,
  COUNT(m.member_id) AS total_members,
  COUNT(DISTINCT t.member_id) AS members_with_at_least_one_trip,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT t.member_id) / NULLIF(COUNT(m.member_id), 0),
    2
  ) AS pct_members_with_trip
FROM plans p
LEFT JOIN members m
  ON m.plan_id = p.plan_id
LEFT JOIN trips t
  ON t.member_id = m.member_id
GROUP BY p.plan_id, p.plan_name
ORDER BY pct_members_with_trip DESC, p.plan_name ASC

WITH station_periods AS (
  SELECT
    s.station_id,
    s.station_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN m.reported_at >= '2023-01-01' AND m.reported_at < '2023-07-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS maint_h1_2023,
    SUM(CASE WHEN m.reported_at >= '2024-01-01' AND m.reported_at < '2024-07-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS maint_h1_2024,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.started_at >= '2023-01-01' AND t.started_at < '2023-07-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS trips_started_h1_2023,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.started_at >= '2024-01-01' AND t.started_at < '2024-07-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS trips_started_h1_2024,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.started_at >= '2023-01-01' AND t.started_at < '2023-07-01' AND t.ended_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS trips_completed_h1_2023,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.started_at >= '2024-01-01' AND t.started_at < '2024-07-01' AND t.ended_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS trips_completed_h1_2024
  FROM stations s
  LEFT JOIN maintenance m
    ON m.station_id = s.station_id
  LEFT JOIN trips t
    ON t.start_station_id = s.station_id
  GROUP BY s.station_id, s.station_name
),
rates AS (
  SELECT
    station_id,
    station_name,
    maint_h1_2023,
    maint_h1_2024,
    trips_started_h1_2023,
    trips_started_h1_2024,
    trips_completed_h1_2023,
    trips_completed_h1_2024,
    1000.0 * maint_h1_2023 / NULLIF(trips_completed_h1_2023, 0) AS maint_rate_per_1000_completed_trips_h1_2023,
    1000.0 * maint_h1_2024 / NULLIF(trips_completed_h1_2024, 0) AS maint_rate_per_1000_completed_trips_h1_2024
  FROM station_periods
)
SELECT
  station_id,
  station_name,
  maint_h1_2023,
  maint_h1_2024,
  trips_started_h1_2023,
  trips_started_h1_2024,
  trips_completed_h1_2023,
  trips_completed_h1_2024,
  maint_rate_per_1000_completed_trips_h1_2023,
  maint_rate_per_1000_completed_trips_h1_2024,
  maint_rate_per_1000_completed_trips_h1_2024 - maint_rate_per_1000_completed_trips_h1_2023 AS rate_change
FROM rates
WHERE maint_rate_per_1000_completed_trips_h1_2023 IS NOT NULL
  AND maint_rate_per_1000_completed_trips_h1_2024 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY rate_change DESC, station_id

WITH member_trip_counts AS (
  SELECT
    member_id,
    COUNT(*) AS trip_count
  FROM trips
  WHERE member_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY member_id
),
avg_trip_count AS (
  SELECT AVG(trip_count) AS avg_cnt
  FROM member_trip_counts
),
eligible_members AS (
  SELECT mtc.member_id, mtc.trip_count, m.plan_id
  FROM member_trip_counts mtc
  JOIN members m ON m.member_id = mtc.member_id
  CROSS JOIN avg_trip_count a
  WHERE mtc.trip_count >= a.avg_cnt
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    em.*,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY em.plan_id
      ORDER BY em.trip_count DESC
    ) AS trip_rank
  FROM eligible_members em
),
top_members AS (
  SELECT
    r.plan_id,
    r.member_id
  FROM ranked r
  WHERE r.trip_rank <= 3
),
member_avg_fare AS (
  SELECT
    member_id,
    AVG(fare_cents) AS avg_fare_cents
  FROM trips
  WHERE member_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY member_id
)
SELECT
  p.plan_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT tm.member_id) AS retained_members,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(maf.avg_fare_cents, 0) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(DISTINCT tm.member_id),
    2
  ) AS pct_avg_fare_gt_zero
FROM top_members tm
JOIN plans p ON p.plan_id = tm.plan_id
LEFT JOIN member_avg_fare maf ON maf.member_id = tm.member_id
GROUP BY p.plan_id, p.plan_name
ORDER BY p.plan_name

WITH active_station_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(capacity) AS overall_avg_capacity
  FROM stations
  WHERE is_active = 1
),
borough_avg_capacity AS (
  SELECT borough_id, AVG(capacity) AS avg_capacity
  FROM stations
  WHERE is_active = 1
  GROUP BY borough_id
),
target_boroughs AS (
  SELECT bac.borough_id
  FROM borough_avg_capacity bac
  CROSS JOIN active_station_avg asa
  WHERE bac.avg_capacity > asa.overall_avg_capacity
)
SELECT AVG(wd.temp_c_avg) AS avg_daily_temperature_c
FROM weather_daily wd
JOIN target_boroughs tb
  ON wd.borough_id = tb.borough_id

SELECT
  s.station_id,
  s.station_name,
  b.borough_name,
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(m.job_id) >= 40 THEN 'very_high_maintenance'
    WHEN COUNT(m.job_id) >= 20 THEN 'high_maintenance'
    WHEN COUNT(m.job_id) >= 10 THEN 'moderate_maintenance'
    WHEN COUNT(m.job_id) >= 1 THEN 'low_maintenance'
    ELSE 'no_maintenance'
  END AS maintenance_activity_label,
  COUNT(m.job_id) AS total_maintenance_job_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.bike_id) AS different_bikes_with_jobs,
  CASE
    WHEN s.capacity IS NULL OR s.capacity = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE 1.0 * COUNT(m.job_id) / s.capacity
  END AS jobs_per_capacity_ratio,
  AVG(m.cost_cents) AS average_job_cost_cents,
  MAX(m.cost_cents) AS highest_single_job_cost_cents,
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(m.job_id) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE 1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN m.completed_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(m.job_id)
  END AS open_job_ratio,
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.issue_type) AS different_issue_types_recorded,
  CASE
    WHEN s.is_active = 1 THEN 'active'
    ELSE 'inactive'
  END AS station_status_label
FROM stations s
LEFT JOIN boroughs b
  ON b.borough_id = s.borough_id
LEFT JOIN maintenance m
  ON m.station_id = s.station_id
GROUP BY
  s.station_id,
  s.station_name,
  b.borough_name,
  s.capacity,
  s.is_active
ORDER BY
  total_maintenance_job_count DESC,
  s.station_id ASC

WITH tech_jobs AS (
    SELECT
        t.technician_id,
        t.technician_name,
        COUNT(m.job_id) AS total_jobs,
        SUM(COALESCE(b.total_km, 0)) AS total_bike_km
    FROM technicians t
    JOIN maintenance m
        ON m.technician_id = t.technician_id
    JOIN bikes b
        ON b.bike_id = m.bike_id
    GROUP BY t.technician_id, t.technician_name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        technician_id,
        technician_name,
        total_jobs,
        total_bike_km,
        CASE
            WHEN total_bike_km > 0 THEN (total_jobs * 1000.0) / total_bike_km
            ELSE NULL
        END AS jobs_per_1000_km,
        RANK() OVER (
            ORDER BY
                CASE
                    WHEN total_bike_km > 0 THEN (total_jobs * 1000.0) / total_bike_km
                    ELSE NULL
                END DESC
        ) AS rate_rank
    FROM tech_jobs
)
SELECT
    technician_id,
    technician_name,
    total_jobs,
    total_bike_km,
    jobs_per_1000_km,
    rate_rank
FROM ranked
WHERE rate_rank <= 3
ORDER BY rate_rank, technician_id

SELECT
  b.borough_id,
  b.borough_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.is_active = 1 THEN s.station_id END) AS active_stations,
  COUNT(m.job_id) AS total_maintenance_jobs,
  ROUND(
    1.0 * COUNT(m.job_id) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.is_active = 1 THEN s.station_id END), 0),
    2
  ) AS avg_maintenance_jobs_per_active_station,
  CASE
    WHEN ROUND(
      1.0 * COUNT(m.job_id) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.is_active = 1 THEN s.station_id END), 0),
      2
    ) >= 35 THEN 'very_high'
    WHEN ROUND(
      1.0 * COUNT(m.job_id) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.is_active = 1 THEN s.station_id END), 0),
      2
    ) >= 25 THEN 'high'
    WHEN ROUND(
      1.0 * COUNT(m.job_id) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.is_active = 1 THEN s.station_id END), 0),
      2
    ) >= 15 THEN 'medium'
    WHEN ROUND(
      1.0 * COUNT(m.job_id) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.is_active = 1 THEN s.station_id END), 0),
      2
    ) > 0 THEN 'low'
    ELSE 'none'
  END AS maintenance_intensity_label
FROM boroughs b
LEFT JOIN stations s
  ON s.borough_id = b.borough_id
LEFT JOIN maintenance m
  ON m.station_id = s.station_id
GROUP BY b.borough_id, b.borough_name
ORDER BY avg_maintenance_jobs_per_active_station DESC, b.borough_id

WITH bike_job_rates AS (
  SELECT
    technician_id,
    bike_id,
    AVG(CASE WHEN completed_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS bike_completion_rate
  FROM maintenance
  GROUP BY technician_id, bike_id
),
tech_rates AS (
  SELECT
    technician_id,
    COUNT(*) AS bikes_handled,
    AVG(bike_completion_rate) AS avg_per_bike_completion_rate
  FROM bike_job_rates
  GROUP BY technician_id
)
SELECT
  t.technician_id,
  t.technician_name,
  tr.bikes_handled,
  tr.avg_per_bike_completion_rate
FROM tech_rates tr
JOIN technicians t
  ON t.technician_id = tr.technician_id
ORDER BY tr.avg_per_bike_completion_rate DESC, t.technician_id ASC

WITH station_precip AS (
    SELECT
        s.station_id,
        s.borough_id,
        AVG(w.precip_mm) AS avg_precip
    FROM stations s
    JOIN weather_daily w
      ON w.borough_id = s.borough_id
    GROUP BY s.station_id, s.borough_id
),
overall_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_precip) AS overall_avg_precip
    FROM station_precip
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT sp.*
    FROM station_precip sp
    CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
    WHERE sp.avg_precip > oa.overall_avg_precip
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        f.*,
        MAX(f.avg_precip) OVER (PARTITION BY f.borough_id) AS max_borough_precip
    FROM filtered f
),
survivors AS (
    SELECT
        borough_id,
        station_id,
        avg_precip
    FROM ranked
    WHERE avg_precip = max_borough_precip
)
SELECT
    b.borough_name,
    COUNT(*) AS surviving_stations,
    AVG(s.avg_precip) AS avg_precip_mm,
    CASE
        WHEN AVG(s.avg_precip) >= 2.0 THEN 'very_wet'
        WHEN AVG(s.avg_precip) >= 1.0 THEN 'wet'
        ELSE 'moderate'
    END AS precipitation_label
FROM survivors s
JOIN boroughs b
  ON b.borough_id = s.borough_id
GROUP BY b.borough_id, b.borough_name
ORDER BY b.borough_name

SELECT ROUND(
  100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
    WHEN b.borough_id IS NOT NULL THEN t.technician_id
  END) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM technicians), 0),
  2
) AS percentage
FROM technicians t
LEFT JOIN boroughs b
  ON b.borough_id = t.depot_borough_id
LEFT JOIN weather_daily w
  ON w.borough_id = b.borough_id
 AND w.precip_mm >= 10

SELECT
  t.technician_id,
  t.technician_name,
  b.borough_name AS depot_borough,
  COUNT(m.job_id) AS total_maintenance_jobs,
  COALESCE(COUNT(m.job_id) * 1.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM maintenance), 0), 0.0) AS share_of_all_maintenance_jobs,
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.issue_type) AS different_issue_types_handled,
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(m.job_id) = 0 THEN 0.0
    ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN m.completed_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(m.job_id)
  END AS completion_ratio,
  AVG(m.cost_cents) AS average_maintenance_cost_cents,
  MAX(m.cost_cents) AS maximum_maintenance_cost_cents,
  AVG(
    CASE
      WHEN m.completed_at IS NOT NULL
      THEN julianday(m.completed_at) - julianday(m.reported_at)
    END
  ) AS average_completion_time_days,
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(m.job_id) = 0 THEN 'no_jobs'
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN m.completed_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'has_open_jobs'
    ELSE 'all_completed'
  END AS workload_label
FROM technicians t
LEFT JOIN boroughs b
  ON b.borough_id = t.depot_borough_id
LEFT JOIN maintenance m
  ON m.technician_id = t.technician_id
GROUP BY
  t.technician_id,
  t.technician_name,
  b.borough_name
ORDER BY
  share_of_all_maintenance_jobs DESC,
  t.technician_id ASC

WITH borough_temp AS (
  SELECT
    borough_id,
    AVG(temp_c_avg) AS avg_temp_c
  FROM weather_daily
  GROUP BY borough_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    borough_id,
    avg_temp_c,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_temp_c DESC) AS temp_rank
  FROM borough_temp
),
top_boroughs AS (
  SELECT borough_id, avg_temp_c
  FROM ranked
  WHERE temp_rank <= 2
)
SELECT
  b.borough_id,
  b.borough_name,
  tb.avg_temp_c,
  AVG(t.hourly_rate_cents) AS avg_hourly_pay_cents,
  COUNT(t.technician_id) AS technician_count
FROM top_boroughs tb
JOIN boroughs b
  ON b.borough_id = tb.borough_id
LEFT JOIN technicians t
  ON t.depot_borough_id = b.borough_id
GROUP BY
  b.borough_id,
  b.borough_name,
  tb.avg_temp_c
ORDER BY tb.avg_temp_c DESC, b.borough_id

WITH member_trip_spans AS (
  SELECT
    m.member_id,
    m.plan_id,
    julianday(MAX(t.ended_at)) - julianday(MIN(t.started_at)) AS trip_span_days
  FROM members m
  JOIN trips t
    ON t.member_id = m.member_id
  WHERE t.ended_at IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY m.member_id, m.plan_id
)
SELECT
  p.plan_name,
  COUNT(*) AS member_count,
  AVG(trip_span_days) AS avg_trip_span_days,
  MIN(trip_span_days) AS min_trip_span_days,
  MAX(trip_span_days) AS max_trip_span_days
FROM member_trip_spans mts
JOIN plans p
  ON p.plan_id = mts.plan_id
GROUP BY p.plan_id, p.plan_name
ORDER BY avg_trip_span_days DESC

SELECT
  t.technician_id,
  t.technician_name,
  b.borough_name AS depot_borough,
  COUNT(m.job_id) AS total_jobs_assigned,
  SUM(CASE WHEN m.completed_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jobs_completed,
  SUM(CASE WHEN m.completed_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jobs_open,
  ROUND(
    1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN m.completed_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(m.job_id),
    3
  ) AS completion_rate,
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(m.job_id) = 0 THEN 'no_jobs'
    WHEN 1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN m.completed_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(m.job_id) >= 0.95 THEN 'excellent'
    WHEN 1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN m.completed_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(m.job_id) >= 0.80 THEN 'good'
    WHEN 1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN m.completed_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(m.job_id) >= 0.60 THEN 'fair'
    ELSE 'poor'
  END AS completion_class
FROM technicians t
JOIN boroughs b
  ON b.borough_id = t.depot_borough_id
JOIN maintenance m
  ON m.technician_id = t.technician_id
GROUP BY
  t.technician_id,
  t.technician_name,
  b.borough_name
ORDER BY
  completion_rate DESC,
  total_jobs_assigned DESC,
  t.technician_id ASC

WITH in_service_bikes AS (
    SELECT bike_id
    FROM bikes
    WHERE status = 'in_service'
),
bike_station_totals AS (
    SELECT
        m.station_id,
        m.bike_id,
        SUM(m.cost_cents) AS total_cost_cents
    FROM maintenance m
    JOIN in_service_bikes b
      ON b.bike_id = m.bike_id
    WHERE m.station_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY m.station_id, m.bike_id
),
station_avgs AS (
    SELECT
        station_id,
        AVG(total_cost_cents) AS avg_bike_maintenance_cost
    FROM bike_station_totals
    GROUP BY station_id
),
overall_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(total_cost_cents) AS overall_avg_bike_station_cost
    FROM bike_station_totals
),
qualified_stations AS (
    SELECT sa.station_id
    FROM station_avgs sa
    CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
    WHERE sa.avg_bike_maintenance_cost > oa.overall_avg_bike_station_cost
),
station_top_counts AS (
    SELECT
        bst.station_id,
        COUNT(*) AS top_bike_count
    FROM bike_station_totals bst
    JOIN (
        SELECT
            station_id,
            MAX(total_cost_cents) AS max_total_cost_cents
        FROM bike_station_totals
        GROUP BY station_id
    ) mx
      ON mx.station_id = bst.station_id
     AND mx.max_total_cost_cents = bst.total_cost_cents
    GROUP BY bst.station_id
)
SELECT
    s.station_id,
    s.station_name,
    stc.top_bike_count
FROM qualified_stations qs
JOIN station_top_counts stc
  ON stc.station_id = qs.station_id
JOIN stations s
  ON s.station_id = qs.station_id
WHERE stc.top_bike_count = (
    SELECT MAX(stc2.top_bike_count)
    FROM station_top_counts stc2
    JOIN qualified_stations qs2
      ON qs2.station_id = stc2.station_id
)
ORDER BY s.station_id

WITH member_trip_stats AS (
  SELECT
    t.member_id,
    COUNT(*) AS trip_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN b.status = 'in service' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_service_trip_count,
    MIN(t.started_at) AS earliest_start,
    MAX(COALESCE(t.ended_at, t.started_at)) AS latest_end
  FROM trips t
  JOIN bikes b ON b.bike_id = t.bike_id
  WHERE t.member_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY t.member_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
     AND SUM(CASE WHEN b.status = 'in service' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 3
)
SELECT AVG(julianday(latest_end) - julianday(earliest_start)) AS avg_span_days
FROM member_trip_stats

WITH member_stats AS (
  SELECT
    m.member_id,
    m.plan_id,
    AVG(t.duration_sec) AS avg_trip_duration_sec,
    COUNT(t.trip_id) AS trip_count,
    AVG(t.distance_km) AS avg_trip_distance_km,
    MAX(t.distance_km) AS max_trip_distance_km,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.promo_code IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS promo_trip_count,
    SUM(COALESCE(t.fare_cents, 0)) AS total_fare_cents
  FROM members m
  LEFT JOIN trips t
    ON t.member_id = m.member_id
  GROUP BY m.member_id, m.plan_id
),
plan_stats AS (
  SELECT
    plan_id,
    AVG(avg_trip_duration_sec) AS avg_member_avg_trip_duration_sec,
    COUNT(*) AS total_members,
    SUM(CASE WHEN trip_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_members,
    1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN trip_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS active_member_ratio,
    AVG(trip_count) AS avg_trips_per_member,
    AVG(avg_trip_distance_km) AS avg_member_avg_trip_distance_km,
    MAX(max_trip_distance_km) AS longest_single_trip_distance_km,
    AVG(CASE WHEN trip_count > 0 THEN 1.0 * promo_trip_count / trip_count END) AS avg_promo_share_among_active_members,
    AVG(total_fare_cents) AS avg_total_fare_per_member_cents
  FROM member_stats
  GROUP BY plan_id
)
SELECT
  p.plan_name,
  ps.avg_member_avg_trip_duration_sec,
  ps.total_members,
  ps.active_members,
  ps.active_member_ratio,
  ps.avg_trips_per_member,
  ps.avg_member_avg_trip_distance_km,
  ps.longest_single_trip_distance_km,
  ps.avg_promo_share_among_active_members,
  CASE
    WHEN ps.avg_total_fare_per_member_cents < 2000 THEN 'low_value'
    WHEN ps.avg_total_fare_per_member_cents < 5000 THEN 'mid_value'
    ELSE 'high_value'
  END AS revenue_band
FROM plan_stats ps
JOIN plans p
  ON p.plan_id = ps.plan_id
ORDER BY ps.avg_member_avg_trip_duration_sec DESC

WITH member_trip_counts AS (
  SELECT
    m.member_id,
    m.plan_id,
    COUNT(t.trip_id) AS trip_count
  FROM members m
  LEFT JOIN trips t
    ON t.member_id = m.member_id
  GROUP BY m.member_id, m.plan_id
),
plan_counts AS (
  SELECT
    plan_id,
    COUNT(*) AS total_members
  FROM member_trip_counts
  GROUP BY plan_id
),
trip_freq AS (
  SELECT
    plan_id,
    trip_count,
    COUNT(*) AS members_with_count
  FROM member_trip_counts
  GROUP BY plan_id, trip_count
),
running AS (
  SELECT
    tf.plan_id,
    tf.trip_count,
    tf.members_with_count,
    SUM(tf.members_with_count) OVER (
      PARTITION BY tf.plan_id
      ORDER BY tf.trip_count
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS cumulative_members
  FROM trip_freq tf
),
median_pick AS (
  SELECT
    r.plan_id,
    r.trip_count,
    r.members_with_count,
    r.cumulative_members,
    pc.total_members,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY r.plan_id
      ORDER BY r.trip_count
    ) AS rn
  FROM running r
  JOIN plan_counts pc
    ON pc.plan_id = r.plan_id
  WHERE r.cumulative_members >= (pc.total_members + 1) / 2.0
)
SELECT
  p.plan_id,
  p.plan_name,
  mp.trip_count AS median_trip_count,
  mp.members_with_count,
  mp.cumulative_members,
  mp.total_members
FROM median_pick mp
JOIN plans p
  ON p.plan_id = mp.plan_id
WHERE mp.rn = 1
ORDER BY p.plan_id

WITH member_trips AS (
  SELECT
    bike_id,
    member_id,
    date(started_at) AS trip_day
  FROM trips
  WHERE member_id IS NOT NULL
),
bike_stats AS (
  SELECT
    bike_id,
    COUNT(*) AS total_member_trips,
    COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS distinct_members,
    COUNT(DISTINCT member_id || '|' || trip_day) AS member_days
  FROM member_trips
  GROUP BY bike_id
)
SELECT
  b.bike_id,
  b.status,
  bs.total_member_trips,
  bs.distinct_members,
  bs.member_days,
  1.0 * bs.total_member_trips / bs.member_days AS trips_per_member_day
FROM bike_stats bs
JOIN bikes b ON b.bike_id = bs.bike_id
ORDER BY
  trips_per_member_day DESC,
  bs.total_member_trips DESC,
  b.bike_id ASC

SELECT
  s.station_id,
  s.station_name,
  COUNT(t.trip_id) AS total_trips_started,
  COUNT(DISTINCT t.member_id) AS distinct_members_started,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.plan_id IS NOT NULL THEN t.member_id END) AS distinct_plan_members_started,
  ROUND(
    1.0 * COUNT(t.trip_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.plan_id IS NOT NULL THEN t.member_id END),
    2
  ) AS trips_per_plan_member
FROM stations AS s
JOIN trips AS t
  ON t.start_station_id = s.station_id
JOIN members AS m
  ON m.member_id = t.member_id
WHERE m.plan_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY s.station_id, s.station_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.plan_id IS NOT NULL THEN t.member_id END) > 0
ORDER BY trips_per_plan_member DESC, total_trips_started DESC
